capability.summary: Fetch World Bank indicator observations for one country
capability.description: Fetches one World Bank country/indicator series using the fixed v2 endpoint, JSON format, and per_page=5. HTTP 2xx/3xx responses produce a success envelope; HTTP 4xx/5xx responses produce an error envelope and a non-zero exit; request exceptions also produce an error envelope and a non-zero exit.
capability.problem_space: Country-level development-indicator data retrieval; not forecasting, causal analysis, or financial advice.

constraint.io_signature: Input: country code and World Bank indicator code; output: JSON envelope containing http_status and the World Bank metadata/observation array or HTTP error body. HTTP 2xx/3xx responses produce a success envelope; HTTP 4xx/5xx responses produce an error envelope and a non-zero exit; request exceptions also produce an error envelope and a non-zero exit.
accepted_inputs: World Bank country code or country identifier
World Bank indicator code such as a numeric series id
constraint.output_shape: HTTP 2xx/3xx: {status: "success", tool: string, url: string, http_status: integer, result: object|string}. HTTP 4xx/5xx: {status: "error", tool: string, url: string, http_status: integer, result: object|string}, exit 1. Request exception: {status: "error", tool: string, message: string}, exit 1.
limitations: fixed GET https://api.worldbank.org/v2/country/<country>/indicator/<indicator> with format=json and per_page=5; no date range, page, or sort input exposed
HTTP 2xx/3xx responses produce a success envelope; HTTP 4xx/5xx responses produce an error envelope and a non-zero exit; request exceptions also produce an error envelope and a non-zero exit.
wrapper preserves the API JSON and does not locally truncate beyond the API's five-record page
no auth, cache, or retry; observations and availability depend on the external World Bank service

output_contract.description: JSON envelope containing the World Bank metadata and up to five indicator observations, URL, and HTTP status.

json_schema.description: Native JSON representation only; no field or task-delivery guarantee.
